name: B10-0199/2026 (PPE) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Armenia's democracy, reforms and security. It welcomes closer EU-Armenia ties, new EU missions to help Armenia handle cyberattacks and foreign meddling, and two summits in Yerevan in May 2026. It urges free and fair elections in June 2026, warns against interference from Russia and domestic networks, and asks for EU help for civil society and independent media. It also calls for peace with Azerbaijan, the release of detained Armenians, and regional connectivity. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The EU is asked to deepen support for Armenia's democracy, security and reforms; this affects Armenia and EU institutions.
- The Parliament backs new EU missions and the May 2026 Yerevan summits; Armenia's government and citizens are affected.
- It calls for free June 2026 elections and peace with Azerbaijan; next steps are up to EU bodies and Armenia.
